messages:
Maya Patel: heads-up — sketching a new 'accelerator heartbeat' dashboard that fuses ECC/Xid, nvlink errors, PCI resets, and prefix hit-rate to produce a per-card/rack health score by region. want quick eyeballs before I wire it into alerting.

Owen Chen: love it. can you include a short-term 'flake window' (5m/1h) and a decay score so we stop alerting on one-off blips?

Maya Patel: yep — thinking decay = time-decay weighting so recent events matter more. quick Prom draft below (iterate pls):

```promql
sum by(card_id) (
  increase(nv_gpu_xid_total[1h]) * 10 +
  increase(nv_ecc_uncorrectable[1h]) * 50 +
  increase(pci_reset_count[1h]) * 20
) * (1 / (1 + (time() - scalar(timestamp(last_over_event_time))) / 3600))
```

Rajesh Gupta: can we gate alerts to only fire if the card is serving pods? we got noise when spare cards reported XIDs but weren't in use. i suggest `card_utilization > 0.05` in the rule.

Maya Patel: good call — will add `card_utilization > 0.05 && score > threshold` to the rule and a label `active=true/false` on panels.

Li Wong: how will this interact with the auto-eject automation? current runbook triggers drain after 3 XIDs in 10m. the dashboard should mirror those thresholds and surface the ejection state.

Maya Patel: plan: dashboard is ops-readonly; panels show raw events, rolling score, and current ejection_state from `card_meta`. alerts live in infra-alerts repo. dashboard will include a link to the drain runbook and the last ejection job log.

sre-ops: also please add a cross-region capacity panel — if a region loses >5% healthy cards, we need visible remaining throughput and suggested failover targets. tagging @Maya Patel for the panel.

Maya Patel: :thumbsup: adding a small table that estimates region_capacity using `avg_tokens_per_gpu` * healthy_cards, plus a spare_pool_estimate.

dashbot: grafana PR opened: https://git.company.com/redwood/grafana/dashboards/pull/4321

Owen Chen: nice. can you also add a correlation panel overlaying gpu_temp and nvlink_error_rate? last week heat spikes lined up with a batch of ECCs.

Maya Patel: yep — plan to overlay percentile lines (p95/p99) and an event mark for firmware updates or rack reboots.

Li Wong: cost note: if thresholds are too conservative we'll cause a lot of drains and spare capacity churn. SRE should simulate spare pool cost impact before we flip alerting to production.

sre-ops: we'll run a staging simulation tomorrow and estimate cost delta for a range of thresholds. propose a fleet SLO: healthy-card per-region >= 98.5% over a 30-day window, with a legacy-hardware exemption to 97.5% and an auto-rollback policy.

Rajesh Gupta: 98.5% is tight for older racks — agree on legacy exemption. also add a 'grace' label so we don't evict if utilization is <0.1 and spare pool <15%.

Maya Patel: noted — I'll add hardware-generation annotations per-rack so ops can filter by gen. will include grace rules in the alerting PR. posting updated PR when ready.

dashbot: PR merged -> dashboards/accel-heartbeat.json (main)

Owen Chen: thanks! can we do a quick 15m sync after the staging run to review thresholds and dashboard panels?

sre-ops: scheduled: tomorrow 10:30 PT — invite sent.

Maya Patel: thanks everyone :rocket:
